offering_description.value: Masimo sells noninvasive patient monitors, sensors and monitoring software to hospitals, home care providers, medical equipment manufacturers and consumers. It designs and manufactures monitoring systems and supplies sensor technology that other manufacturers integrate into their equipment.

primary_products.value: Pulse oximeters and sensors; capnography and gas monitors; brain function monitors; hemodynamic monitors; hospital connectivity and remote patient monitoring software

primary_services.value: Hospital monitoring system integration; equipment maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, health systems, clinics, home care providers and medical equipment manufacturers; B2G: Government-operated hospitals and health systems; B2C: Individuals and families buying home monitoring devices

end_markets.value: Acute and critical care; perioperative care; home healthcare; medical equipment manufacturing; consumer health monitoring

revenue_model.value: product sales: Monitoring equipment, disposable and reusable sensors, and embedded monitoring modules; service fees: Equipment maintenance and repair

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns electronic and optical components into monitors and sensors for care providers and consumers; component supplier: Supplies embedded monitoring modules and sensors to medical equipment manufacturers; software / platform: Collects and routes device data for hospital care teams and remote monitoring programs; service provider: Integrates monitoring systems and services equipment for healthcare organizations
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Oxygenation, respiratory, brain function and hemodynamic monitoring, plus hospital connectivity and home monitoring

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving hospitals, health systems and medical equipment manufacturers; distributors / dealers: Medical equipment distributors serving healthcare providers; partners / resellers: Equipment manufacturers that embed monitoring technology in their own systems; online: Company web store for home monitoring devices and accessories
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Clinical monitoring devices are subject to FDA premarket requirements and EU medical device rules.

notes: The current scope of the consumer home monitoring lineup is uncertain.
